pages.speaker: character20
pages.text: MAN, I WAS DOING SO WELL. I REALLY THOUGHT I HAD IT NAILED.

pages.speaker: character20
pages.text: BUT I GUESS THERE'S NOTHING I CAN DO ABOUT IT NOW.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: SEE!? THAT RIGHT THERE! OKAWA, YOU'RE ALWAYS SO LAID BACK! WHERE'S YOUR THIRST FOR BLOOD?

pages.speaker: character20
pages.text: WELL, IT’S FINALLY TIME. US THIRD YEARS ARE RETIRING FROM THE EQUESTRIAN CLUB TODAY!

pages.speaker: character20
pages.text: THE FIRST YEAR’S FIRST COMPETITION IS IN OCTOBER, SO CONTINUING DOING YOUR BEST AND MAKE THE CLUB PROUD!

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: RIGHT!

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: YODA, WE'D LIKE YOU TO TAKE OVER AS THE NEXT CLUB PRESIDENT.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: THANK YOU!

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: AND FOR THE VICE-PRESIDENT...

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: I GUESS THAT MAKES SENSE. YODA-SAN IS THE ONLY SECOND YEAR HERE... THEY'RE GOING TO MAKE ONE OF US FIRST YEARS THE VICE-PRESIDENT?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I BET IT’S GOING TO BE MIKAGE. SHE’S THE BEST OUT OF ALL OF US HERE, ONE IN FIVE ODDS... PLEASE DON’T LET IT BE ME .••.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: HACHIKEN. WE’RE COUNTING ON YOU.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: WHAAAT!? WAIT JUST A MINUTE!!

pages.speaker: character19
pages.text: CON- GRATS!

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: GOOD LUCK, HACHIKEN! HEY, YOU MADE VICE-PRESIDENT!

pages.speaker: character15
pages.text: GOOD LUCK!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: GOOD WORK TODAY, EVERYBODY!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YEAH, GREAT JOB GUYS!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YODA. HACHIKEN. YOU'RE TAKING OVER, SO CAN YOU HANG BACK FOR A MINUTE? SURE.

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: EHHH HHH!?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WHY DID YOU CHOOSE ME?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THERE'S NO WAY YOU CAN TELL ME THAT MIKAGE ISN'T WAY BETTER THAN I AM!

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THIS IS ABOUT BEING A TEAM MANAGER. IT HAS NOTHING TO DO WITH HOW GOOD YOU ARE.

pages.speaker: character20
pages.text: HACHIKEN, YOU’RE HONEST WITH YOURSELF AND OTHERS NO MATTER WHAT THE SITUATION IS, AREN’T YOU?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: HM?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I GUESS... BUT I'M STILL AGAINST THIS, YOU KNOW. I'M NOT EVEN COMPLETELY SURE WHY I CHOSE THIS SCHOOL, EITHER...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: SEE? THAT’S EXACTLY THE HONESTY I WAS TALKING ABOUT. But don't BRAGGING about things like that!
